podcast.body: As one of the top songs on AM radio in 1974, it was considered "horribly, horribly irrelevant" given the turbulent state of the world at the time. "One shine on my shoulder from John Denver."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This 1971 ballad was re-recorded by Denver in 1973 for his 'Greatest Hits' compilation, featuring a rich string section and benefiting from his improved singing and studio facilities. Its popularity was significantly boosted by its inclusion in the 1973 made-for-TV movie "Sunshine," a rating smash about a young mother battling cancer. This exposure helped the song become a belated chart smash, reaching number one on the Hot 100 by March 1974. "The single that benefited most from this approach was a 1971 ballad that Denver augmented in 73 with a rich string section, the gentle sunshine on my shoulders."
